title: ECG explanation-route integrity, localization and recovery under unchanged predictions
scope: technical route integrity on real PTB-XL signals with controlled explanation-stage corruptions; no diagnostic truth or physician assessment

cohort.selection: sort by SHA256('20261126:'+ecg_id), one recording per patient, by frozen predicted class and confidence >=0.9; 16 high confidence and 8 other per predicted class

reference: verified actual checkpoint, data preparation, raw samples, independent fixed-target IG and temporal occlusion on standardized tensors

map_tolerance.scope: same method, target, baseline and grid only; IG versus occlusion disagreement is diagnostic not defect ground truth

repairs: registered verified independent artifacts, restore only diagnosed explanation node with explicit sandbox approval; rebuild graph from actual repaired arrays and revalidate via RouteRecertifier; negative unavailable-source control
outcomes: block or restore original clean action
number of artifacts restored vs full rebuild
limitations: controlled interventions on 48 distinct real patients, not prevalence estimates or clinical validation; paired conditions are not independent samples; no superiority over equal-information rules assumed
